description: This source file defines the TimerSchedulerTask class, which extends TimerTask and facilitates execution and management of scheduled tasks within the OpenMRS scheduler framework. It includes methods for running tasks, saving execution times, shutdown procedures, and error handling.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerTask
classes.description: Class extending TimerTask to manage scheduled task execution, including running tasks, logging, error handling, updating last execution time, and shutdown functionality.

methods.name: TimerSchedulerTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TimerSchedulerTask with a specific Task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the scheduled task and handles exceptions. Logs any fatal errors encountered during execution.

methods.name: saveLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Updates the last execution time of the task in its TaskDefinition and saves it through the SchedulerService.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Cancels the timer and invokes the task's shutdown method.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the given task and updates its last execution time, ignoring interruption and execution exceptions.
